parsed.explanation: The quote is verbatim under 'Current best' and, in context, is an open to-do item — it literally ends with 'Strategy for X?'. Checking the whole text: 'Full proof' reads '(To be completed)'; the remaining sections contain only brute-force small-n searches, a hedged conjecture, and the remark that Xiang 'seems to be' able to reply to Liu's specific equal-spacing marks with equal-length pieces. No construction of a Xiang reply for an arbitrary Liu division appears anywhere, and nothing proves Liu's total is capped at any value of c. The upper-bound obligation is therefore nowhere established, exactly as the objection states. This is fatal: without any Xiang strategy, maximality of c is entirely unsupported (indeed the conjectured value (n+1)/(2n+1) also fails to match the correct 2^n/(2^{n+1}-1) beyond n=1).
